title: K-flat computation and triangulatedness of a specified scalar-extension counit
statement: Let C be a site essentially small relative to the coefficient universe r, with sheafification of abelian-group presheaves and the local-bijection characterization used for module sheaves. Let phi:R -> S be a morphism of sheaves of commutative rings. Let E be additive ordinary sheafified scalar extension, specified on objects and maps by changeOfRings and changeOfRingsHom. Let (F,epsilon) be any universal left derived pair for termwise E on cochain complexes and derived localization, allowing independent Hom universes for D(R) and D(S). Give F a coherent integer shift such that epsilon commutes with shifts. Then F is triangulated for that shift, and epsilon_P is invertible for every K-flat R-complex P, without any termwise flatness assumption.

source.place: Tags 06YS, 06YT and 06YY; derived.tex Tags 06XN, 05SU and 05SE, as used in the parent proof steps 2–5.

proof.text: Take the existing cochain derived-change-of-rings model with independent universes. The prescribed objects and maps identify its ordinary functor with E by a natural isomorphism. Transport its universal pair, and compare it to the given one by uniqueness of right Kan extensions. The counit comparison transfers invertibility at every K-flat complex.

Pass the given counit to homotopy categories along the full essentially surjective homotopy quotient. Apply the scalar-extension counit-shift theorem. Its uniqueness clause identifies its triangulated degree-one comparison with the given one, since commutation of epsilon with shifts is its defining equation. Therefore the given F preserves distinguished triangles.

theorem scalarExtension_counit_properties
    (φ : R ⟶ S)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wR} (ringedSiteModules.{r} (derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J R))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wS} (ringedSiteModules.{r} (derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J S))]
    (E : ringedSiteModules.{r} (derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J R) ⥤
      ringedSiteModules.{r} (derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J S))
    (h : ∀ M : ringedSiteModules.{r} (derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J R),
      E.obj M = changeOfRings.{v, u, r} φ M)
    (hmap : ∀ {M N : ringedSiteModules.{r} (derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J R)}
      (f : M ⟶ N),
      E.map f = eqToHom (h M) ≫ changeOfRingsHom.{v, u, r} φ M f ≫ eqToHom (h N).symm)
    [E.Additive]
    (F : DerivedCategory (ringedSiteModules.{r} (derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J R)) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (ringedSiteModules.{r} (derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J S)))
    (ε : DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ F ⟶ E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
    [F.IsLeftDerivedFunctor ε
      (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso
        (ringedSiteModules.{r} (derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J R)) (.up ℤ))]
    [F.CommShift ℤ] [NatTrans.CommShift ε ℤ] :
    F.IsTriangulated ∧
      ∀ P : CochainComplex
        (ringedSiteModules.{r} (derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J R)) ℤ,
        CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (J := J) (R := R) P →
          IsIso (ε.app P)
